sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) Vanessa Enoteca page, read through search summaries only (the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine): Thread Magic to mend and alter clothes; Trap Magic; Compound Magic; Arachne's Web; the Red Thread of Fate whose cat is Rouge.
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (the official 魔法騎士名鑑 post on X for Rouge, pixiv encyclopedia, manga-tantei, manga-legend, anitubu episode 64 review): バネッサ, 糸魔法「運命の赤い糸」, the cat ルージュ, awakened in episode 64.
sources.repo: A page that already existed in the mod's Thread book (names carried over from the earlier wiki pass of the 0.34 and 1.43 releases); no source for it could be re-read this round.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells_bulls.md.

spells.name: Thread Magic: Red Thread
spells.note: Her basic thread: binds, whips and pulls. Mode 0 of the Thread book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Thread Magic: Mending
spells.note: The wiki's first listed use: she mends and alters clothing for her squadmates.

spells.name: Arachne's Web
spells.note: Named on her wiki page; a web of threads that holds a crowd. The episode of its first use was not confirmed.

spells.name: Thread Trap Generation (Trap Magic)
spells.note: The wiki lists Trap Magic for her; the page was already locked to her grimoire.

spells.name: Arresting Dark Weave
spells.note: Already her exclusive page; not re-confirmed this round.

spells.name: Dancing Doll
spells.note: Threads move a body like a puppet; not re-confirmed this round.

spells.name: Red Thread of Fate: Rouge
spells.ja: 運命の赤い糸 ルージュ
spells.note: Her signature: the cat Rouge. Awakened in episode 64 after she had fought with the plain thread for a long time, so it needs the Red Thread cast five times first. While the cat is out it bends fate for the Black Bulls.

spells.name: Dancing Doll: Recall
spells.note: A follow-up of the Dancing Doll, so it needs the doll cast first.

spells.name: Reinforcement Magic and Mana Skin
spells.note: The Mana Method the Black Bulls learned late in the story; already locked to her.

planned.name: Door of Fate (Compound Magic with Finral)
planned.note: Listed on her wiki page as a compound spell; the page lives in the Spatial book and is in Finral's set.

planned.name: Thread Whip / Thread Binding Magic / Thread Cocoon
planned.note: Names from the mobile game databases only (not the series): no page.

notes: No new page was needed: every canon spell she used already had a page in the Thread book. The Black Bulls flair (a thread web ring, a burst of strings, the Rouge fate tap aura) is added on top of her casts by book.CharacterFlairBulls.
